title: Finance Research API Response
description: Response shape for You.com Finance Research API — returns finance-grade research answer with inline citations and source list.

output.description: The research output containing the answer and sources.

content.description: Markdown-formatted finance research answer with inline citations [[1, 2]] referencing the sources array. Max length ~50,000 chars.
content.example:
**NVIDIA FY2025 Revenue Analysis**

**Key drivers:**
- **Data Center revenue** up 142% to $47.5B, driven by Hopper architecture demand for LLMs and generative AI [[1]]
- **Compute & Networking** up 145%, with Blackwell production systems shipping in Q4 [[1]]
- **Gaming** up 9% on GeForce RTX 40 Series adoption [[2]]

content_type.description: Always 'text' — the content field contains Markdown-formatted text.

sources.description: List of web sources used to generate the answer. Each source is cited inline using [[1]], [[2]] notation in the content field.

url.description: URL of the source webpage that was read and cited.

snippets.description: Relevant excerpts from this source that were used in generating the answer.

items.example: Revenue for fiscal year 2025 ended January 26, 2025 was $130.5B, up 114% year over year.

output.content:

| **Google / Alphabet** | **59.7%** [[3]] | **58.2%** [[3]] | **56.6%** [[3]] | Middle, improving each year. |

sources.title: Apple Inc. - 10K - Annual Report - October 31, 2025
snippets: Gross margin for fiscal 2025 was 46.9% compared to 46.2% in fiscal 2024

sources.title: United States Securities and Exchange Commission - Apple 10-K 2025
snippets: Apple's fiscal 2025 revenue was $391.0B with gross margin of $183.6B

snippets: Microsoft gross margin for FY2025 was 68.8% on revenue of $281.7B

notes.finance_research_vs_research: The Finance Research API returns the same response shape as the Research API, but uses a finance-optimized index: SEC filings, earnings reports, analyst coverage, market data, financial news. Use Finance Research for company analysis, earnings summaries, competitive benchmarking, due diligence, and macroeconomic research. Use Research API for general-purpose research or when you need source_control or output_schema parameters.
notes.citations: Inline citations [[1, 2]] in the content field reference items in the sources array by their zero-based index. Always follow citations to primary sources for compliance-sensitive use cases.
notes.max_input_length: The input field accepts up to 40,000 characters. Responses can be up to ~50,000 characters.
